style: Say clearly and steadily, like a trusted radio news reader
lines: Press Power, then drag the tuning knob or tap Station to find a station.
Press Power to hear the station. Then use the controls below the radio.
Station A is pinned. Now turn the dial to a second station.
Press Flip to switch between the two stations at the next bar.
Turn the Beat, Harmony or Sound knob to another era. The change starts at the next bar.
Listen, then drag the pin to the year you hear and press Tune in.
Set done. Your count is on the screen.
Tap Station or drag the tuning knob. Press Compare to pin this sound, then find another station.
Press Flip to compare A and B at the next bar, or turn the dial.
Keep turning the tuning knob until the green eye closes and the station locks.
Press Power to hear the hidden station. Then move the year pin and press Tune in.
Press Power, then turn a Beat, Harmony or Sound knob to hear a new mix.
Compare the two highlighted clues, then press Next station.
Press New set to hear six different stations. Results are not saved.
Listen, then drag the year pin or use its arrow keys. Press Tune in to reveal the station.
The knobs show your new mix. Listen for it at the next bar.
Press Resume to hear the radio again. You can still change the controls while paused.
